dc_eval_cbrn.quote: we performed uplift testing designed to assess whether use of the Llama models could meaningfully increase the capabilities of malicious actors to plan or carry out attacks using these types of weapons

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Our cyber attack uplift study investigated whether the Llama 3 family of LLMs can enhance human capabilities in hacking tasks, both in terms of skill level and speed.
dc_eval_cyber.locator: Critical and other risks, 3. Cyber attack enablement

dc_eval_autonomy.note: 'autonomous agents in cyber offensive operations' is agentic cyber, coded cyber per boundary rule; 'autonomy of all users' is unrelated

ext_test_any.note: red team composition given but not stated to be outside Meta; 'partnered early with subject-matter experts' were consulted to derive goals, not stated to test; content-specialist red teaming is tied to Llama 3, not this model; 'third party' refers to deployers' services

ext_test_named_org.note: no outside testing organisation named; AI Alliance, Partnership on AI, MLCommons are consortium memberships
